scope: Fixed operator Web API origin and consistent versioned paths; no multi-server implementation, version binary lifecycle or collaboration protocol claim.

configuration.format: UTF-8 JSON object; only optional apiBaseUrl key
configuration.providedValue: nonblank absolute HTTP(S) API root; root or trailing /v1 alias; no userinfo/query/fragment/ambiguous navigation
configuration.failure: safe accessible load/invalid state before Koin/API; reload after operator correction
configuration.persistence: one immutable startup snapshot; fetch no-store, omit credentials, refuse redirects; no query/global/user preference override

architecture: Parsing/URI/network mechanics in data/platform adapters; composition root loads then wires existing domain ports; presentation consumes URL use cases, never Ktor URI policy.

riskFamilies.risk: Absent override: actual page origin supplies the origin and exactly one `/api/v1` prefix; no localhost fallback.
Explicit valid cross-origin HTTP localhost configuration preserves port and the configured authority.
HTTPS override preserves TLS; an HTTPS host page refuses a disallowed HTTP downgrade before requests.
Bare origin, trailing slash, `/api` and existing `/api/v1/` alias canonicalize under the specified compatibility contract.
Explicit custom root/proxy prefix survives ordinary API calls and generated locations without duplication or removal.
IPv4, hostname and bracketed IPv6 authorities preserve nondefault/default port semantics.
Empty, whitespace-only or non-string provided configuration is a visible safe failure, not absence/default.
Invalid schemes, missing authority and malformed/out-of-range ports are rejected before client creation.
Embedded userinfo, query and fragment in operator configuration are rejected without echoing their values.
Control/backslash, ambiguous encoded separators and dot/navigation path forms cannot select another endpoint.
Malformed percent encoding/ambiguous empty segments follow the explicit grammar; valid supported encoded prefixes round-trip once.
Mutation of the host config after startup cannot split client, Coil/presentation and link-generation roots.
Actual app startup failure is accessible/actionable and produces zero backend calls; fixing operator config and reloading recovers.
Auth/login/profile storage requests retain method/query/JSON and reach the effective prefixed API.
Every remaining production API data source uses the same root; inventory all request construction sites, not a favorable sample.
Generic non-API paths used by BaseApi/transport contracts keep their existing semantics.
Bearer values are read freshly; token rotation/logout and allowed origin/prefix behavior do not regress or put tokens in public URLs.
Multipart/chunk requests and binary downloads preserve body bytes, headers, destination and error outcomes after rebasing.
Storage IDs containing Unicode, slash, question mark and hash remain one encoded path segment.
Existing ApiLocation sanitation of inherited base user/password/query/fragment remains covered independently from strict startup rejection.
Prefixed public-share requests suppress token-bearing URL logs and Authorization remains sanitized on ordinary requests.
Thumbnail/preview/binary/folder ZIP URLs all preserve the root and exact existing operation routes.
Copy/display/open public-share URLs agree with the effective root and actual backend public-page route.
Version-generated URLs match the real route, with an explicit assertion that metadata is not historical binary-download acceptance.
Socket URL scheme/prefix is consistent; tests do not pretend to fix or prove the separate collaboration protocol.
Public share GET view loads CSS/JS, validates the intended capability and submits to the prefixed same-origin endpoint.
A rejected password POST at the deeper download URL renders working assets/form/retry and does not expose credentials.
Public-page pathname parsing refuses unrelated/malformed routes; it cannot issue off-origin capability requests.
Public success/download/revoke/expired outcomes retain existing limits, CSP/referrer/log protections and bounded partial state.
Standalone dev entrypoint and root production package remain operational under their documented configuration.
Desktop/common production client consumers retain legacy configuration behavior and complete applicable test suites.
Network/body cancellation and request timeout remain distinct and cannot become empty/Unit success.
Production package A, one clean browser origin: normal login, files, upload and actual saved binary/ZIP byte identity.
The identical production package B, a distinct host/port plus explicit proxy prefix: same real journey without rebuilt endpoint constants.
Logged-out actual public-link journey on both origins: page/assets/form and saved download bytes use the right prefix.
Malformed real served operator config yields visible error and no API traffic; operator-only correction/reload restores the normal journey.

Actual configured Coil client sends current scoped bearer and no-store, bypasses unscoped memory/disk cache, rejects foreign/tokenless access, and text preview uses the authenticated domain port with safe cancellation/error and unchanged displayed cap. Unbounded full-body preview/media support is not certified.
Real CORS preflight honors each configured origin scheme/host/port and Cache-Control request header; unconfigured HTTP counterpart, host and port stay denied. No wildcard/origin broadening.

acceptance: At least all38 families expanded into actual assertions; complete final suites/gates/lint/contracts, raw source-bound coverage, actual same package on two production origins including prefixed proxy/public flow and bad-config recovery. Planned families are not executed test counts.
